page_title: HOF 2-1 DOR | Hoffenheim v Dortmund 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' That's it for today, Daniel Siebert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+13' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
90+11' Poor challenge! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is penalised for tripping and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Dortmund.
90+10' The referee can't ignore those comments and Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90+8' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Gregor Kobel no chance!
90+8' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+7' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+6' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Hoffenheim using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+6' That looked a certain handball by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+3' Dortmund fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+2' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' The attendance for today's match is 30150.
87' 1 - 1 Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
85' The referee blows his whistle as Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
84' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Siebert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tim Lemperle.
82' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
81' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch for Bernardo.
71' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Daniel Svensson is replaced by Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
71' It is time for a substitution. Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) is on for Marcel Sabitzer.
67' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
65' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
63' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
63' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
62' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hoffenheim.
60' Here's the change. Wouter Burger leaves the pitch and Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
60' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Bazoumana Toure will be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
60' Substitution. Fabio Silva makes his way off the pitch and Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) comes on as his replacement.
60' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
58' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
56' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
51' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
49' A cross from a corner kick by Dortmund is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
47' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45+1' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
42' Niklas Sule is substituted due to injury. Niko Kovac gives a chance to Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gregor Kobel into right side of the goal.
41' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
40' Referee Daniel Siebert awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
39' Referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hoffenheim. Let’s see what happens!
39' Surely that's handball by one of the Dortmund players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
37' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
36' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
35' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
31' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
28' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
26' Excellent touch by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
25' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Maximilian Beier, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
23' Dortmund hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

22' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Siebert with no other option than to blow for a foul.
18' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
18' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
15' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
14' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from inside the 18-yard box. His effort floats over the bar by a whisker!
13' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
11' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' A spell of possession for Hoffenheim in an attempt to control the game.
7' The foul by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
1' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
1' Hoffenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
